master.definition_en: A benign adipose tissue neoplasm of the pleural cavity. It may be purely intra-thoracic or extend to the chest wall.

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 睡梦与突发危象的实时监测预警
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 在数分钟至数小时黄金窗到来前，提前发出异常信号
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 以遗传性易栓症、急性肺栓塞、主动脉夹层、恶性心律失常和脑出血为代表的急症，平时毫无征兆，往往在睡梦中或静息状态下几分钟内危及生命——家人根本来不及反应。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 需要发展连续无创可穿戴微循环/血氧/心电多模态传感器、血液微凝血活性快速试纸，结合 AI 在异常触发前几小时识别微血栓与高危信号并立即叫醒预警。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 时序多模态生理异常检测 + 血液高凝状态前置生物标志物发现 + 低成本家系表型筛查算法。

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 急诊极危重期的快速再通与器官细胞保护
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 把“几分钟决定生死”的抢救窗口拓宽成“几小时可救回”
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 对急性心梗、脑梗死、脓毒性休克、急性肝衰竭与热射病而言，哪怕送到急诊室，微血管再灌注损伤、细胞因子风暴和不可逆线粒体坏死仍会在短时间内夺走生命。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 研发免复杂配型的超快精准溶栓与导管微取栓器械、阻断微血栓级联炎症风暴药物，以及在缺血缺氧期守住心肌与脑神经元存活的细胞保护剂。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 急性多器官微循环级联动力学建模、急诊快速炎症/凝血表型分型、老药新用紧急器官保护筛选。

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 单基因遗传缺陷与缺失蛋白的源头修复
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 从“提心吊胆终身服药/等待突发”走向“一次修复致病根源”
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 许多遗传病并非细胞坏了，只是基因编码少了关键一环（如 SERPINC1 缺少抗凝血酶“刹车蛋白”、SMN1 缺乏、凝血因子或酶缺陷），让患者自出生起就暴露在高危或渐进衰退中。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 推进高精度体内 CRISPR 碱基/先导编辑、低免疫原性肝/神经靶向病毒载体（AAV）与脂质纳米颗粒（LNP）递送，以及患者自体干细胞精准修复移植，让身体自己恢复生产正常蛋白。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: AI 指导低脱靶编辑器设计、肝脏/心肌/神经组织特异启动子预测、蛋白功能残基致病性建模。

master.definition_en: An extranodal lymphoma that arises from the esophagus with the bulk of the mass located in the esophagus. Dysphagia may be the presenting symptom. The vast majority of cases are diffuse large B-cell lymphomas and B-cell lymphomas of the mucosa-associated lymphoid tissue.

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 单基因遗传缺陷与缺失蛋白的源头修复
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 从“提心吊胆终身服药/等待突发”走向“一次修复致病根源”
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 许多遗传病并非细胞坏了，只是基因编码少了关键一环（如 SERPINC1 缺少抗凝血酶“刹车蛋白”、SMN1 缺乏、凝血因子或酶缺陷），让患者自出生起就暴露在高危或渐进衰退中。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 推进高精度体内 CRISPR 碱基/先导编辑、低免疫原性肝/神经靶向病毒载体（AAV）与脂质纳米颗粒（LNP）递送，以及患者自体干细胞精准修复移植，让身体自己恢复生产正常蛋白。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: AI 指导低脱靶编辑器设计、肝脏/心肌/神经组织特异启动子预测、蛋白功能残基致病性建模。

master.definition_en: A neoplasm of lymphoblasts committed to the B-cell lineage, typically composed of small to medium-sized blast cells. When the neoplasm involves predominantly the bone marrow and the peripheral blood, it is called B acute lymphoblastic leukemia. When it involves nodal or extranodal sites, it is called B lymphoblastic lymphoma. (WHO, 2001)

mechanisms: T cell surface glycoprotein CD3 cross-linking agent

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 睡梦与突发危象的实时监测预警
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 在数分钟至数小时黄金窗到来前，提前发出异常信号
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 以遗传性易栓症、急性肺栓塞、主动脉夹层、恶性心律失常和脑出血为代表的急症，平时毫无征兆，往往在睡梦中或静息状态下几分钟内危及生命——家人根本来不及反应。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 需要发展连续无创可穿戴微循环/血氧/心电多模态传感器、血液微凝血活性快速试纸，结合 AI 在异常触发前几小时识别微血栓与高危信号并立即叫醒预警。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 时序多模态生理异常检测 + 血液高凝状态前置生物标志物发现 + 低成本家系表型筛查算法。

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 急诊极危重期的快速再通与器官细胞保护
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 把“几分钟决定生死”的抢救窗口拓宽成“几小时可救回”

master.definition_en: A disease characterized by the build-up of fatty material and calcium deposition in the arterial wall resulting in partial or complete occlusion of the arterial lumen.

curated.lethality_detail_zh: 1) 动脉粥样硬化是冠心病、心肌梗死、脑梗死和外周动脉疾病的共同“土壤”——血液中过高的低密度脂蛋白胆固醇（LDL-C）与炎症细胞数十年如一日地钻入动脉内膜，形成像小米粥一样的脂质斑块，使血管管腔逐渐变窄; 2) 真正致命的往往不是缓慢变窄本身，而是“不稳定易损斑块”突然破裂诱发急性血栓，在数分钟内彻底堵死心脏或大脑血管，引发急性心梗或大面积脑梗死。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 虽无法靠药物让严重钙化的斑块彻底消失，但通过强效降脂（将LDL-C降至极低水平可实现部分软斑块逆转消退）、控压控糖、抗炎及戒烟，可使脆弱的斑块外壳变厚变稳固，将急性心梗和脑卒中风险降低50%–70%以上。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: WHO GHE与GBD 2021未将“动脉粥样硬化”单独归因统计，其下游并发症（缺血性心脏病约900万/年、缺血性脑卒中约330万/年）合计占全球总死亡的约1/4–1/3

annual_deaths_china.source: 《中国心血管健康与疾病报告2023》

curated.lethality_detail_zh: 静止期胆囊结石多无症状，但结石嵌顿可诱发急性胆囊炎、急性梗阻性化脓性胆管炎（AOSC）或胆源性重症胰腺炎，数小时至数日内因感染性休克或多器官衰竭致命。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 有症状或高危胆囊结石通过腹腔镜胆囊切除术（LC）可彻底根治；胆总管结石可通过内镜逆行胰胆管造影（ERCP）取石治愈。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: GBD 2021将胆石症、胆囊炎及胆管炎合并统计为“胆囊和胆道良性疾病”（ICD-10 K80–K83.9），未单列胆石症独立全球死亡人数；死亡主要源于并发急性化脓性胆管炎、坏疽穿孔及胆源性重症胰腺炎。
annual_deaths_global.source: GBD 2021 Gallbladder and Biliary Diseases Collaborators

annual_deaths_china.range_or_note: 中国官方死因监测未单列胆石症独立死亡数；因人口基数大，东亚地区胆道疾病绝对住院与并发症负担居全球前列。

epidemiology.prevalence_global: 全球成人胆石症患病率约10%–15%（欧美约10%–20%，女性及高BMI人群显著高发）。
epidemiology.prevalence_china: 中国成人胆石症总体患病率约10%–11%（部分流调约11.0%），1990–2021年绝对患病人数随老龄化与肥胖率上升持续增加。

clinical_management.acute_emergency_protocol_zh: 120一分钟识别与避坑：若右上腹剧痛持续超4–6小时不缓解，伴寒战高热（>38.5℃）、皮肤巩膜发黄（黄疸）、意识模糊或血压下降（急性化脓性胆管炎五联征），或向腰背部放射伴剧烈呕吐（警惕胆源性胰腺炎），立即拨打120！严禁进食油腻食物、严禁盲目服用强效止痛药掩盖病情或迷信偏方“排石”（易致结石卡顿胆总管诱发重症胰腺炎）；立即禁食水急诊就医。

research_progress.breakthroughs_and_trials_zh: 单孔腹腔镜、经自然腔道内镜手术（NOTES）及SpyGlass胆道子母镜直视下激光/液电碎石技术已广泛应用于复杂肝内外胆管结石；人工智能超声影像辅助识别微小胆囊结石与早期胆囊癌变正处于临床验证阶段。
research_progress.key_unmet_needs_zh: 1) 胆色素结石与混合性结石目前无有效溶石药物，只能依赖手术或内镜取石; 2) 胆管结石取石术后高复发率及肝内胆管结石难治性狭窄问题突出; 3) 盲目“保胆取石”后结石高复发率与非规范排石偏方导致的急诊并发症仍需科普规范。

master.definition_en: Anemia resulting from bone marrow failure (aplastic or hypoplastic bone marrow). The production of erythroblasts and red cells is markedly decreased, and it may be associated with decreased production of granulocytes (granulocytopenia) and platelets (thrombocytopenia) as well. Aplastic anemia may be idiopathic or secondary due to bone marrow damage by toxins, radiation, or immunologic factors.

curated.category: 非恶性血液病 / 骨髓造血衰竭综合征
curated.lethality_detail_zh: 以T淋巴细胞异常亢进破坏造血干祖细胞引起全血细胞减少及骨髓脂肪化为核心；非重型(CAA)多呈多年慢性经过，而重型/极重型再障(SAA/VSAA)未及时行免疫抑制或造血干细胞移植者，1–2年内常于数周内因重度粒缺败血症、侵袭性真菌病或颅内出血致命（自然病死率>70%）。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 高度可治性骨髓衰竭病：年轻患者有全相合/单倍体供者行异基因造血干细胞移植治愈率达80%–90%；无移植指征或中老年SAA依托抗胸腺细胞球蛋白(ATG)+环孢素联合TPO受体激动剂(艾曲泊帕/海曲泊帕)血液学缓解率已提升至70%–80%。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: WHO GHE与GBD 2021未单列再生障碍性贫血全球独立死因总数（并入广义贫血/血液系统疾病）；重型再障未经有效治疗1年病死率极高(>70%)

clinical_management.acute_emergency_protocol_zh: 极重型中性粒细胞<0.2×10^9/L伴高热立即入层流保护性隔离，留取病原后即刻联合广谱抗细菌+抢先抗曲霉/毛霉真菌治疗；血小板极低(<10×10^9/L)或黏膜活动出血急诊输注单采血小板。

research_progress.key_unmet_needs_zh: 高龄重型再障患者对强免疫抑制及移植耐受性依然较差；IST后约10%–15%远期向MDS/AML或PNH克隆演变；免疫抑制后复发难治仍具挑战。

master.definition_en: A drug-related embryofetopathy that can occur when an embryo/fetus is exposed to carbamazepine and that is characterized by facial dysmorphism, with some similarities to that seen in fetal valproate syndrome (see this term), such as epicanthal folds, upward slanting palpebral fissures, short nose, micrognathia and malar hypoplasia, as well as nail dysplasia and major anomalies including cleft lip/palate, neural tube defects and cardiac anomalies. In utero exposure to carbamazepine, in combination with valproate, has been associated with significant developmental delay (particularly affecting verbal intelligence) and a high rate of congenital anomalies.

master.definition_en: Mazabraud syndrome is a rare primary bone dysplasia characterized by the association of fibrous dysplasia with intramuscular myxomas. Fibrous dysplasia (usually polyostotic, sometimes monostotic) occurs during the growth period and can be asymptomatic or can present with pain, skeletal deformities or fractures while intramuscular myxoma, associated with polyostotic fibrous dysplasia is usually multifocal, typically occurring in the vicinity of skeletal lesions, and presents in adulthood as a painless soft-tissue mass (most commonly in the thigh). Although it is a benign condition, local recurrences of myxomas after incomplete excision and malignant transformation of a fibrous dysplastic lesion into osteogenic sarcoma have been reported.

master.definition_en: Angioosteohypotrophic syndrome is a rare, congenital, vascular anomaly syndrome characterized by venous or, on occasion, arterial malformations which lead to soft tissue hypertrophy and bone hypoplasia. Affected limb is generally shortened, highly deformed, painful and edematous and associates bone and muscle hypotrophy. Single parts, or multiple small parts, of limbs are typically affected but more extensive involvement, including complete extremity, shoulder girdle and axilla, has been reported.

curated.category: 急性呼吸道感染 (Acute Respiratory Infection)
curated.lethality_detail_zh: Omicron及后续亚变株总体致病力较早期毒株显著下降，但未免疫的高龄老人、肿瘤、移植及免疫缺陷者仍可于感染后数日至2周内进展为“沉默性低氧血症”、病毒性重症肺炎、ARDS、肺栓塞与多器官损伤致死。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 轻中症依托免疫屏障多可自愈；高危人群在症状出现5天内尽早口服小分子3CLpro抗病毒药（如先诺欣、帕罗韦德或来瑞特韦等）可大幅压低重症住院与死亡风险；重症伴低氧血症以糖皮质激素+抗凝+器官支持救治，部分长新冠（Long COVID）疲劳脑雾仍缺乏根治特效药。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: WHO全球卫生估计（GHE）记录2021年COVID-19在全球跃升为第2大死因，直接/相关致死约880万人（WHO估算2020–2021两年全球超额全因死亡合计达1,480万–1,490万人）；至2023年随着群体免疫建立，已跌出WHO全球十大死因前列。

master.definition_en: An autosomal recessive disorder characterized by onset of megaloblastic anemia associated with decreased serum vitamin B12 (cobalamin, Cbl) in infancy or early childhood. Low molecular weight (LMW) proteinuria is frequently present, but usually occurs later and is usually mild or subclinical. Patients often present with vague symptoms, including failure to thrive, loss of appetite, fatigue, lethargy, and/or recurrent infections. Treatment with vitamin B12 results in sustained clinical improvement of the anemia. The proteinuria is nonprogressive, and affected individuals do not have deterioration of kidney function; correct diagnosis is important to prevent unnecessary treatment. The disorder results from a combination of vitamin B12 deficiency due to selective malabsorption of the vitamin, and impaired reabsorption of LMW proteins in the proximal renal tubule. These defects are caused by disruption of the AMN/CUBN complex that forms the 'cubam' receptor responsible for intestinal uptake of B12/GIF (CBLIF).

breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 把药真正送进大脑、心脏与深层致密病灶
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 神经退行性疾病（渐冻症 ALS、阿尔茨海默病、帕金森）、胶质母细胞瘤与纤维化器官病往往不是没发现靶点，而是大分子药进不去血脑屏障，或普通小分子误伤全身。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 突破跨血脑屏障转运体载体、GalNAc-siRNA / ASO 精密肝脏与中枢基因沉默调控、靶向蛋白降解嵌合体（PROTAC）及虚拟细胞药效预测技术。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 可穿屏障肽/纳米载体生成式设计、RNA 序列稳定与毒性预测、多组学虚拟细胞扰动响应仿真。

master.definition_en: A rare otorhinolaryngological malformation characterized by a hypoplastic or absent cochlear nerve, resulting in variable hearing loss or total deafness, depending on the quantity of nerve fibers present. The condition can be unilateral or bilateral, occur as an isolated malformation or in the context of a complex syndrome, and may be associated with a hypoplastic internal auditory or cochlear nerve canal.

master.definition_en: A rare isolated cerebellar malformation characterized by a normal shape but reduced volume of the cerebellar vermis and hemispheres with no other neurological anomalies or extracerebral congenital malformations. The majority of patients present with impaired ambulation, global developmental delay, with or without intellectual disability. Other signs might include hypotonia, truncal, appendicular and gait ataxia, as well as oculomotor abnormalities.
